column1: # K-Klimb, G-Get and S-Search on the Britannia overworld.
# The corpus of decoded stock captures shows no scenario reaching any of these
# three verbs outdoors, which is how several invented engine lines survived
# until the crate-wide message inventory found them. This walks the shared
# overworld caster seed through all three in one run so whatever the original
# prints - result or refusal - is on record.
# Measured 2026-09-12, clean at 4 of 4. `Klimb-With what?` is the gearless
# overworld form of `commands.md` Section 5.2; `Get-North` / `Nothing to get!`
# and `Search-North` / `Thou dost find` / `nothing of note.` are Section 5.8's
# empty results. That Search pair is the first *measurement* of the row break
# this engine was given from the section's prose alone in an earlier fix.
# requires-seed: the party on the Britannia overworld at 02:00 with spell
